description: Screenshot of Q drop #1316 (May 4 2018) on 8chan, which re-posts an earlier Q drop from 04/27/18 listing FBI officials described as fired or cooperating witnesses, then adds an updated list of FBI and DOJ officials the drop claims were fired, forced out, or demoted. The drop frames these departures as evidence of a conspiracy being dismantled ('THE SWAMP IS BEING DRAINED. TRUST THE PLAN.'). All firing/cooperation characterizations are the drop's claims.

description: Screenshot of Q drop text linking to a justice.gov file and listing 'Figure 3.1 - FBI Chain of Command for the Midyear Investigation' (the DOJ Inspector General report on the Clinton email probe). It lists FBI officials with claimed statuses such as FIRED or POWER REMOVED, then poses names of other FBI employees with question marks and asserts an attempted 'biggest cover up in US history'. All characterizations are the drop's claims.
text: https://www.justice.gov/file/1071991/download. Figure 3.1 - FBI Chain of Command for the Midyear Investigation. James Comey - FBI Director - FIRED. Jim Rybicki - Chief of Staff (JC) - FIRED. Andrew McCabe - Deputy Director - FIRED. James Baker - Office of General Counsel - FIRED. Bill Priestap - Head of Counterintelligence (Strzok's boss) - POWER REMOVED / COOPERATING WITNESS. Lisa Page - Special Counsel - FIRED. Peter Strzok - Lead Investigator/Deputy Asst Director of Counterintelligence - POWER REMOVED / ESCORTED OUT [CLAS-F]. Michael Steinbach?. John Glacalone?. Randy Coleman?. Trisha Anderson?. Kevin Clinesmith?. Tashina Gauhar?. Sally Moyer?. NOTHING TO SEE HERE?. LOGICAL THINKING. BIGGEST COVER UP IN US HISTORY [ATTEMPTED]. Q
flags: 'FIRED', 'POWER REMOVED', 'cooperating witness' and 'biggest cover up' statements are the Q drop's unverified claims
'John Glacalone' as written appears to be a misspelling of John Giacalone

description: Organizational chart page (page 45) from the DOJ Inspector General report: 'Figure 3.1: FBI Chain of Command for the Midyear Investigation'. Boxes and arrows show the FBI reporting hierarchy for the Clinton email ('Midyear') investigation, from Director James Comey down through the deputy director, NSB, Counterintelligence Division, general counsel's office, and agent/analyst levels, with names and tenure dates in each box.
text: Figure 3.1: FBI Chain of Command for the Midyear Investigation. FBI Director James Comey. Chief of Staff Jim Rybicki. Special Counsel Lisa Page (February 2016-March 2018). Deputy Director Andrew McCabe (February 2016-March 2018) Mark Giuliano (November 2013-January 2016). NSB EAD Michael Steinbach (February 2016-February 2017) John Giacalone (July 2015-February 2016). Office of General Counsel Jim Baker. AD Counterintelligence Division (CD) E.W. "Bill" Priestap (January 2016-Present) Randy Coleman (May 2014-December 2015). NSCLB Deputy General Counsel Trisha Anderson. NSCLB Attorneys FBI Attorney 1 FBI Attorney 2. Agent Lead Pete Strzok. Lead Analyst. Supervisory Special Agent. Agents. Analysts. 45

description: Video still/screen capture at a political rally. A man seen from behind — with distinctive styled blond-orange hair and dark suit, consistent with President Donald Trump — faces a cheering crowd behind a barrier; a press camera is at right. A woman in the front row wears a shirt printed with a large Q logo and the slogan 'WWG1WGA' (partially visible), and another attendee wears a red MAGA-style cap while others raise phones.
terms: where we go one we go all
flags: Central figure is seen only from behind; identification as Donald Trump is based on distinctive hair, build, and rally context rather than a visible face
Shirt slogan partially obscured; transcribed as the standard WWG1WGA slogan
Crowd members are private individuals and are not identified
